statements.en: Nearly 2400 people were arrested on Saturday during the day of mobilization against the expensive life of violence, and nearly a thousand police officers and gendarmes were injured, seven of whom were seriously, according to a consolidated assessment by the Ministry of the Interior.

statements.quote: More than 500 police officers have been injured, France's Interior Minister Laurent Nunez posted on X on Sunday, warning that "nothing can justify" the unrest.
Some 550,000 protesters hit the streets across France, including 110,000 in Paris, Nunez said on Saturday.
Police have detained more than 2,000 people, Nunez said, adding that more than 600 police officers were injured.
More than 600 police officers have been injured, France's Interior Minister Laurent Nunez posted on X on Sunday, warning that "nothing can justify" the unrest.
Récit Samedi, 800 000 personnes ont défilé selon les organisateurs, 550 000 selon le ministre de l’intérieur, Laurent Nuñez.
statements.who: organisers or unions; Interior Minister (Laurent Nuñez)
statements.en: On Saturday, 800,000 people marched according to the organizers, 550,000 according to the Minister of the Interior, Laurent Nuñez.

statements.quote: Prime minister Sebastien Lecornu said more than 900 police had also been injured.

La journée de contestation , au huitième anniversaire de l'émergence des gilets jaunes et après plusieurs semaines d'agitation lycéenne, s'est soldée par quelque 2 000 interpellations et 600 blessés dans les rangs des forces de l'ordre, selon le ministre de l'Intérieur, Laurent Nuñez.
statements.en: On the eighth anniversary of the emergence of the yellow vests and after several weeks of high school agitation, the day of contestation resulted in some 2,000 arrests and 600 injuries in the ranks of the law enforcement forces, according to the Minister of the Interior, Laurent Nuñez.

statements.quote: Nearly 2,400 people were arrested in France during a day of protests against the high cost of living that turned violent, with almost 1,000 police officers and gendarmes injured, the interior ministry said Sunday.

French President Emmanuel Macron on Sunday expressed the public's “anger” and “shame” over nationwide protests against rising living costs and poor conditions in schools that have resulted in at least 1,800 arrests.

Quelque 1.800 personnes ont été interpellées dans le cadre des violences et pillages commis en France samedi 17 octobre et jusque dans la nuit, a indiqué dimanche le ministre de l'Intérieur Laurent Nuñez, qui se rendra à Marseille lundi.
statements.en: Some 1,800 people were arrested in the context of the violence and looting committed in France on Saturday 17 October and until the night, said Minister of the Interior Laurent Nuñez, who will be going to Marseilles on Monday.

statements.quote: Laurent Nuñez se rendra lundi à Marseille, où samedi "des exactions (ont été) commises par plusieurs milliers d'individus d'ultragauche", ensuite "rejoints par des délinquants qui ont pillé et saccagé de nombreux commerces".
statements.en: Laurent Nuñez will visit Marseille on Monday, where on Saturday "exacts (were) committed by several thousand ultra-left-wing individuals", then "jointed by criminals who looted and ransacked many businesses".

statements.quote: À Paris, plus de 500 personnes sont en garde à vue ce dimanche, a indiqué le parquet de la capitale dans un bilan « pas encore consolidé ».
statements.en: In Paris, more than 500 people are in custody this Sunday, said the capital's prosecutor's office in a "not yet consolidated" assessment.

statements.quote: Les forces de l’ordre avaient interpellé « 855 » personnes samedi à Paris, un « chiffre record », a annoncé dimanche la préfecture de police (PP) dans un bilan à 08 h 00.
statements.en: The police had arrested "855" people on Saturday in Paris, a " record number", the police prefecture (PP) announced on Sunday in a review at 0800 hours.

statements.quote: Selon la préfecture de police, cette unité spécialisée, qui avait déjà été engagée samedi, notamment dans le secteur des Halles, est « engagée place de la République » , où de vives tensions sont en cours, avec des affrontements entre plusieurs centaines de personnes et les forces de l’ordre.
statements.en: According to the police prefecture, this specialized unit, which had already been engaged on Saturday, especially in the Halles sector, is "committed to the Place de la République", where there are intense tensions, with clashes between several hundred people and the police forces.

statements.quote: Près de 2 400 personnes ont été interpellées samedi lors de la journée de mobilisation contre la vie chère émaillée de violences, et près d'un millier de policiers et gendarmes ont été blessés, dont sept gravement, selon un bilan consolidé du ministère de l'Intérieur.
statements.en: Nearly 2,400 people were arrested on Saturday during the day of mobilization against the expensive life of violence, and nearly 1,000 police officers and gendarmes were injured, seven of whom were seriously, according to a consolidated assessment by the Ministry of the Interior.

statements.quote: Le bilan objectif du ministre de l'Intérieur hier est un désastre absolu : - des dizaines de milliers de personnes empêchées d'exercer le droit fondamental de manifester en paix - des villes entières abandonnées aux casseurs pendant que des manifestants pacifiques étaient…
statements.en: The objective balance sheet of the Minister of the Interior yesterday is an absolute disaster: - tens of thousands of people prevented from exercising the fundamental right to demonstrate in peace - whole cities abandoned to breakers while peaceful demonstrators were...

statements.quote: Il assure que près de cent policiers municipaux étaient mobilisés samedi aux côtés de la police nationale. il indique que 33 policiers nationaux ont été blessés dans la Ville rose et leur adresse tout son soutien.
statements.en: He claims that almost 100 municipal police officers were mobilized Saturday alongside the national police. He reports that 33 national police officers were injured in the Pink City and address them with all his support.

statements.quote: En réalité, entre 5 et 10 magasins ont été pillés et 25 ont été ciblés, indique la préfecture de Haute-Garonne à La Dépêche.
statements.en: In fact, between 5 and 10 stores were looted and 25 were targeted, reports the Haute-Garonne prefecture in La Défense.

statements.quote: Le Premier ministre Sébastien Lecornu va présider ce dimanche à 19h une cellule interministérielle de crise, au lendemain des violences qui ont éclaté en marge des manifestations du 17-octobre, a annoncé Matignon. cette réunion portera sur trois volets, "économie-commerce", "assurance" et "suivi judiciaire", a fait savoir Matignon.
statements.who: the Prime Minister; organisers or unions
statements.en: Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu will preside this Sunday at 7 p.m. an interministerial crisis unit, following the violence that broke out on the margins of the 17-October protests, announced Matignon. This meeting will focus on three aspects, "economy-commerce", "insurance" and "judicial monitoring", Matignon said.

statements.quote: Le ministre de l'Intérieur Laurent Nuñez indique sur X que 1800 personnes ont été interpellées dans le cadre des violences et pillages commis en France samedi et jusque dans la nuit.
statements.en: Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez says about X that 1800 people were arrested in the context of the violence and looting committed in France on Saturday and until the night.

statements.quote: A Toulouse, 94 personnes sont en garde à vue, selon un bilan établi peu avant minuit par la préfecture.
statements.en: In Toulouse, 94 people are in custody, according to a report drawn up shortly before midnight by the prefecture.

statements.quote: Le ministre de l'intérieur sera en déplacement à Marseille lundi, où "des exactions (ont été) commises par plusieurs milliers d'individus d'ultragauche", ensuite "rejoints par des délinquants qui ont pillé et saccagé de nombreux commerces".
statements.en: The Minister of the Interior will be travelling to Marseilles on Monday, where "exacts (were) committed by several thousand ultra-left-wing individuals", then "rejoined by criminals who looted and ransacked many businesses".

statements.quote: Le parquet de Paris annonce que 517 personnes sont placées en garde à vue après les violences et pillages samedi dans la capitale. 346 de ces personnes sont majeures et 171 mineures.
statements.en: The Paris Public Prosecutor's Office announces that 517 people are being held in police custody after the violence and looting in the capital on Saturday. 346 of these people are adults and 171 minors.

statements.quote: Selon un bilan établi peu avant minuit, 94 personnes ont été interpellées à Toulouse samedi en raison des violences, saccages et pillages. 1500 à 2000 individus "préparés, cagoulés et équipés pour piller, vandaliser et affronter les forces de l’ordre" se sont mêlés aux manifestants et ont déambulé en ville, selon la préfecture de Haute-Garonne.
statements.en: According to an assessment made shortly before midnight, 94 people were arrested in Toulouse on Saturday because of the violence, ransacks and looting. 1500 to 2000 individuals "prepared, camouflaged and equipped to loot, vandalize and confront the forces of the law" mixed up with the demonstrators and wandered around the city, according to the prefecture of Haute-Garonne.

statements.quote: Les forces de l'ordre ont interpellé "855" personnes samedi à Paris, un "chiffre record", a annoncé ce dimanche la préfecture de police dans un bilan établi à 8h.
statements.en: The law enforcement agencies called "855" people on Saturday in Paris, a "highest figure", announced this Sunday the police prefecture in an assessment made at 8 a.m.

statements.quote: Dans la capitale, 13 policiers et gendarmes ont été blessés ainsi que deux sapeurs-pompiers, a ajouté la préfecture de police, qui a fait état de "groupes violents, caractérisés par leur volume inhabituel (500 à plus de 1000)".
statements.en: In the capital, 13 police officers and gendarmes were injured, as well as two firefighters, added the police prefecture, which reported "violent groups, characterized by their unusual volume (500 to more than 1000)".

statements.quote: Jusqu’à 32 000 personnes, selon la préfecture de la Haute-Garonne (80 000 pour la CGT), ont défilé samedi 17 octobre à Toulouse.
statements.en: Up to 32,000 people, according to the prefecture of the Haute-Garonne (80,000 for the CGT), marched Saturday 17 October in Toulouse.

statements.quote: La préfecture a annoncé à 23h30 l'interpellation de 94 personnes.
statements.en: The prefecture announced at 11:30 pm the arrest of 94 people.

statements.quote: Parti à la rencontre de CRS samedi en fin de soirée à Paris, le Premier ministre Sébastien Lecornu a annoncé que 1200 personnes ont été interpellées au cours de la journée de samedi pour des violences, des pillages et des dégradations.
statements.en: Left at the meeting of CRS on Saturday evening in Paris, Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu announced that 1200 people were arrested during Saturday's day for violence, looting and degradation.

statements.quote: Près de 2.400 personnes ont été interpellées samedi lors de la journée de mobilisation contre "la vie chère" émaillée de violences, et près d'un millier de policiers et gendarmes ont été blessés, dont sept gravement, selon un bilan consolidé du ministère de l'Intérieur.
statements.en: Nearly 2,400 people were arrested on Saturday during the day of mobilization against "the expensive life" imbued with violence, and nearly 1,000 police officers and gendarmes were injured, seven of whom were seriously, according to a consolidated assessment by the Ministry of the Interior.

statements.quote: Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said 1,800 people were arrested over the protests and looting, with investigations under way “to identify the perpetrators of these acts so they can be brought to justice”.
Around 500 police, firefighters and paramedics were hurt in the protests, the interior minister said.
The violence took place on the sidelines of nationwide protests that the interior ministry said were attended by 550,000 people.
The CGT union said 800,000 people participated.

The French president Emmanuel Macron has slammed rioters saying 'How can French people do this to France?' in an address to the nation, as 2,000 people have now been arrested amid the ongoing rallies.
Authorities said that around 550,000 people took part in the protests yesterday, but organisers claim the figure is closer to 800,000.
France's interior minister Laurent Nunez said more than 500 police officers, gendarmes and firefighters have been injured in the demonstrations.
Macron will make an address to the nation tonight after days of violent protests erupted across France, leading to thousands of arrests with hundreds of police officers left injured.
Le ministre de l'Intérieur annonce 400 interpellations dans toute la France
statements.en: Interior Minister announces 400 arrests throughout France

statements.quote: France's General Confederation of Labour (CGT) has said almost 800,000 people have participated in the protests across the country today.
France's interior minister, Laurent Nuñez, has given an update stating around 400 people were arrested.
Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said in televised update that around 550,000 people participated in demonstrations across France today.
People close to Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez say that roughly 32,800 people had taken part in 140 protests across the country already.
On Sunday interior minister Laurent Nuñez announced that the number of arrests had gone up to 1,800.
The violence began on the sidelines of marches in the capital and other cities which the interior ministry reported were attended by 550,000 people.
The police watchdog is investigating at least two dozen allegations of police violence, while the French prime minister said that more than 900 police officers had been injured.
French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said 150 police officers were injured during the demonstrations, which drew an estimated 550,000 people nationwide, the BBC reported.

La Préfecture de police de Paris a fait état de 108 interpellations à Paris, dimanche, dont 66 dans la soirée, et dénombré au moins cinq enseignes pillées, dont un commerce de vêtements, un magasin Darty à Belleville et deux supermarchés.
statements.en: The Paris Police Prefecture reported 108 arrests in Paris on Sunday, 66 of them in the evening, and counted at least five looted signs, including one clothing store, one Darty store in Belleville and two supermarkets.

statements.quote: Ce sont précisément 2 397 interpellations qui ont été effectuées, samedi, lors de la journée de mobilisation contre la vie chère émaillée de violences, selon un bilan du ministère de l’Intérieur.
statements.en: It is precisely 2,397 arrests that were carried out on Saturday during the day of mobilization against the expensive life enamelled with violence, according to a review by the Ministry of the Interior.

statements.quote: «60 blessés chez les forces de l’ordre», déplore Laurent Nuñez
statements.en: "60 injured in law enforcement", deplores Laurent Nuñez

statements.quote: Le ministre de l’Intérieur a évoqué «des débordements très graves» lors desquels 60 policiers ont été blessés.
statements.en: The Minister of the Interior referred to "very serious spills" in which 60 police officers were injured.

statements.quote: Le ministre de l’Intérieur vient de commencer sa conférence de presse par un bref bilan, évoquant 110 défilés sur l’ensemble du territoire qui ont réuni 550.000 personnes, dont 110.000 à Paris (la CGT et d’autres groupes à l’origine de l’organisation avancent le chiffre de 800.000).
statements.who: the Interior Ministry; organisers or unions
statements.en: The Minister of the Interior has just begun his press conference with a brief review, evoking 110 parades throughout the territory that brought together 550,000 people, of which 110,000 in Paris (the CGT and other groups at the origin of the organization put forward the figure of 800,000).

statements.quote: « Des groupes de plusieurs centaines ou de milliers de casseurs, à l’instigation très claire de l’ultragauche, s’en sont pris aux forces de l’ordre », a brocardé Nuñez. 400 interpellations, de personnes majeures en grande majorité, ont déjà eu lieu.
statements.en: " Groups of several hundred or thousands of breakers, at the very clear instigation of the ultra-left, have attacked the forces of law and order, " brocarded Nuñez. 400 arrests, mostly of major persons, have already taken place.
